question: What range of manifestation is described as arising from nāda, bindu, and related principles?
premises: Nāda, bindu, and so forth are described as effects giving rise to the world.
This domain extends upward to Sadāśiva.
This domain extends downward to the earth principle, according to the teaching.
inference: The teaching presents nāda, bindu, and related principles as the source of a manifest domain stretching from Sadāśiva down to earth.
plain_english: Nāda, bindu, and the rest are the effects through which the world arises. In this teaching, that whole domain extends upward to Sadāśiva and downward to the earth principle.
